lines: Again. Remember pulling that sword three times?
The lion's angrier. Don't loosen your parry.
A corner of the tower fell. You're still standing. Come in for tea.
The company calls you weakest. The keep doesn't think so anymore.
Saw through the mist too? Eyes grow before blades.
The tower is waiting. Don't call yourself a hero.
Mist to the southeast. Letters run late; you shouldn't.
Blade's ready. The lion won't hear words. It hears the blade.
Not to prove you're strong. To make it remember what it guards.
The company's weakest? The Sacred Lion is in the sanctum. Raise your blade first.
Techniques only grow when they land. Live to report.
